notes.title: May 28
notes.content:
### New Stuff

- Better inventory ui
- Bomb icon on minimap
- Add option to show full map

### Tweaks

- Adjust reload times
- Remove "bug report" button in favor of "give feedback" button
- Reduce smoke duration from 20 to 15 seconds
- increased most sfx distances

### Bug Fixes

- Minimap remove despawned players
- Flashbang detonation sfx audible on all peers
- Frag detonation audible on all peers
- Grenade not always being thrown
- Weapon picked up sfx audible on all peers
- Weapon netcode
- Shot landing where you're aiming
- Defuse sometimes not working
- Shorter round times after bomb has been planted once
- Consistent fall damage
- *(deagle)* Rotate hammer
- Display correct fps cap
